rules.note: Testing a text event for a section prefix, or cutting the prefix off by its length. owner_lines.why: Song::check_activations, the owner: how far from a measure line a chord may sit

rules.note: Reading either generated-fill rule from a Rules value. Song::check_activations places every generated fill from the measure lines, as Clone Hero's generator does; rules_fields in src/core/rules.cpp names the fields through member pointers, which is loading them, not placing fills. Since D115 TJ-1 check_activations chooses between two generators in song.cpp, Clone Hero 1.1's (place_fills_ch11) and 1.0's (place_fills_ch10), and each reads the two fields. Decided by: D115 (plan part B2, task B2-3)

rules.note: Running a fill generator, or choosing between them, anywhere but the parser. The parser picks the generator from the FillDeadlineRule its caller passes to the parse/song.h loaders; a caller holding a setting converts it with search/graph.h's fill_rule_for. kNotesOnlyFills (parse/song.h) is the one fixed rule allowed, for a caller that reads only the chords; every use is an owner line here, so a caller that reads fills cannot pick it up unnoticed.
